host: Windows with Go 1.27.3 and a local TEI checkout
command: go run ./tools/reference-generator-selection/cmd/tei-generator-build -contract <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document/candidates/card-record/contract.json -strategy text-record-template -out <tmp>/text-record-template && go run ./tools/reference-generator-selection/cmd/tei-generator-select -workspace <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document -contract <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document/candidates/card-record/contract.json -fixtures <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document/candidates/card-record/fixtures.json -candidates <tmp> && go run ./tools/reference-target-profile/cmd/tei-target-profile run -profile <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document/profiles/record.json -workspace <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document -contract <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document/candidates/card-record/contract.json -fixtures <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document/candidates/card-record/fixtures.json -candidates <tmp>
scope: A reference-local record projection contract for SUI Card, generated with text-record-template, selected against four fixtures, and run under a one-shot Target Profile. It does not produce SUI code, a real target deployment, or human acceptance.
